name: Tradune
summary: Tradune is a portfolio tracker for US-market investors that keeps the buy and sell history, computes money-weighted (XIRR) and time-weighted returns from CSV imports with no broker linking, and compares them with the same contributions in an S&P 500 ETF. It also shows public SEC data: a Form 4 insider-trading feed with 10b5-1 plan status and cluster detection, and 13F institutional holdings.
